phrase: AI now erodes people's drive to stick with hard problems, a new study found. Meanwhile buyers are paying extra for art made only by humans.
phraseAlternatives: A new study says ten minutes with AI can weaken a person's grit. At the same time, buyers now pay a premium for art made entirely by humans.
AI chatbots can quietly drain people's patience for hard problems, researchers found. Shoppers, meanwhile, now pay more for art made by human hands.
Ten minutes of AI use can erode a person's grit, a study found. Across the market, human-made art now earns a premium.

brief.concept: A chatbot robot taps a glowing willpower meter down to empty above a tired person stuck on a puzzle, while a shopper nearby happily hands over extra coins for a small artwork stamped HUMAN MADE.
brief.metaphor: AI quietly drains human grit like a battery, even as the market starts paying more for things only a human hand made.

cast.who: a tired person sitting over a half-finished jigsaw puzzle
a small chatbot robot resting a hand on a glowing meter above the person, draining it toward empty
a shopper holding out a handful of extra coins
a small framed artwork stamped HUMAN MADE

brief.composition: Two simple panels side by side on cream paper. Left panel: a tired person at a half-done puzzle, a meter above their head draining from full to empty as a small robot hand taps it down. Right panel: a shopper happily offering extra coins for a small framed artwork stamped HUMAN MADE. No more than 2 main elements per panel; only text in the image is the HUMAN MADE stamp.
brief.alt: Split image: on the left a robot drains a glowing willpower meter above a tired person stuck on a puzzle; on the right a shopper pays extra coins for a small artwork stamped HUMAN MADE.
